verdict.rationale: Codegen's core interaction model is prompt-driven: users describe tasks in natural language and the agent implements features, fixes bugs, and responds via Slack, PR comments, Linear/Jira comments, and SDK calls like agent.run(prompt=...). Multiple surfaces (chat, issue trackers, PR mentions, CLI/SDK) all funnel natural-language commands to the agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs, and no detail on NL command robustness/limitations.
